thread:
Nadia Brooks: dropped a new mock for the on-prem setup wizard  introducing a 'prereq snapshot' ribbon that sits above the stepper. figma: https://figma.com/file/new-prereq-ribbon

Diego Alvarez: interesting. i like the ribbon for teams that skip deep dives. quick note: show only failing checks + a collapsed count (e.g., '2 checks failing  See') to keep it small.

Haruka Sato: copy idea: primary label `Prereqs overview` vs `Readiness snapshot`. prefer `Readiness snapshot`  feels friendlier for ops and non-ops.

Lin Gomez: accessibility: ribbon must be announced when state changes. suggest `role=status aria-live="polite"` and an sr-only summary like "Readiness snapshot: 2 failing checks, last checked 30s ago". include explicit text for icons.

Nadia Brooks: thanks lin. UX question: when ribbon shows failures, should the CTA be `Show fixes` or `Open checklist`? `Show fixes` is more action-oriented.

Diego Alvarez: `Show fixes` is good. also add a tiny chevron to expand to a minimal inline list of failing checks with single-line reasons. clicking an item opens targeted help in the side panel.

Haruka Sato: microcopy for failing reasons (short): "Blocked: egress to storage", "SSH unreachable (port 22)", "DNS: resolves to private IP". keep under ~45 chars.

Lin Gomez: keyboard behavior: ribbon should be tabbable; Enter toggles expand; when expanded focus lands on the first failing check. ensure Esc collapses and returns focus to ribbon. add `aria-expanded` on the chevron button.

design-bot: FYI  automated accessibility scan flagged insufficient focus styles on the ribbon when collapsed.

Nadia Brooks: noted. let's use a 3px high focus ring with accessible contrast. dev: please avoid removes outline: none.

Diego Alvarez: implementation note: the ribbon will pull cached preflight results and refresh on hover or on explicit `Refresh` click. to avoid heavy probes, we'll provide a `Quick recheck` that hits lightweight TCP/DNS checks.

Haruka Sato: can we add copy variants for ribbon CTA? (A) Show fixes (B) Review checks (C) Troubleshoot. we'll test A vs C in research.

Lin Gomez: aria spec I'll drop in the PR: `role=status aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` on ribbon, chevron has `aria-controls` to the inline list id, list uses `role=list` and items `role=listitem`. include sr-only instructions: "Press Enter to open fixes".

Nadia Brooks: UX edge: when multiple hosts, ribbon shows worst state and a pill `3 hosts` that opens a micro-list. micro-list must be keyboard navigable and announce per-host status updates.

Diego Alvarez: we should also expose a `Copy diagnostics` icon per host and a global `Download bundle` in the ribbon footer. add a small toast: "Diagnostics ready" with link to download.

Haruka Sato: copy for empty success state: "All checks passed  Ready to proceed". keep it light and avoid alarmist tone.

Lin Gomez: accessibility suggestion for color: never rely on color alone; include icons plus sr-only text. use patterns from previous audits.

Nadia Brooks: final deliverables for this pass: 1) three CTA copy variants (Haruka), 2) three compact reason examples (Haruka), 3) aria snippet (Lin), 4) recheck API stub and diagnostics contract (Diego), 5) updated figma with focus styles (me). i'll run a quick hallway test later today. :sparkles:
